title: Search
lead: Look for a movie or a series in your library and in every release source at once. What the sources list is kept for a day, so filtering and sorting never ask them again.

form.label: Search for a movie or a series
form.narrow: Add a year, a season or an id to narrow them.

empty.title: Type a title in the search field at the top, then press Enter.
empty.hint: Add the year in brackets after the title to narrow it: “Interstellar (2014)”. A season goes in the Season field once the results are on screen. Press / on any page to jump to the field.

expired: This search is no longer available. Search again.
refreshFailed: Refresh failed, showing the search as it was last loaded.

library.title: In your library
library.empty: Nothing in your library matches this search.
library.wordsLead: Not matched, but a title or a file path holds every word of “{{text}}”:
library.unlisted_one: {{value}} more work in your library holds these words.
library.unlisted_other: {{value}} more works in your library hold these words.

match.label: Why it matched
match.wordsInPath: A file path contains “{{text}}” — not a match
match.wordsHint: Every word searched for is in one of its titles or file paths, but it matched in no other way. It is shown for you to look at, not as a possible match.

inLibrary.Identifier: In your library: {{work}} — matched by id
inLibrary.TitleAndYear: In your library: {{work}} — matched by title and year

match.conflictHint: The ids reported for this work, or the one searched for, don't agree. Nothing was merged: check which one is right.
match.held_one: {{value}} of its episodes in your library
match.held_other: {{value}} of its episodes in your library
match.heldNone: None of its episodes in your library
match.heldHint: How many episodes of the seasons or episodes this release claims your library already holds.

releases.title: Available releases
releases.refreshFailed: Refresh failed, showing the last loaded releases.
releases.none: No source listed a release for this search.
releases.noSources: No release source was searched: none is switched on. The owner adds one under Integrations.

reasons.SecretUnreadable: its stored API key can't be read. The owner enters it again under Integrations.
reasons.TypeUnavailable: this version of the app can't search through its type.
reasons.NoUsableSearch: it offers no search this app can use.

status.UnexpectedResponse: Answered in a way this app can't read.
status.UnsupportedVersion: Runs a version this app can't read.

filters.sizeInvalid: Enter a size in GiB, such as 4.5.

release.noSourcePage: The source gave no page for this release.

details.description: What {{source}} lists for this release, and the copies in your library it may be. Everything on the left is the listing's claim; the facts on the right were read from your files.
details.noClaimedWork: The title gives no year or season, so the app can't tell the name from the rest of it. Any match comes from the description or from an id in the listing.
details.noDescriptionWork: The description gives no year or season, so the app can't tell the name from the rest of it.
details.noIdentifiers: The listing gives no IMDb, TMDb or TVDB id.
details.noLibrary: Nothing in your library matches this release.
